```{r inside101, eval=TRUE, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE}

file_source <- params$"file_source"
    # if(file_source == "from_params") file_source <- "r_source"
file_name <- params$"file_name"
    # if(file_name == "from_params") file_name <- "mtcars"
####----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Configuración de locale a inglés (temporalmente)
current_time <- params$"current_time"
current_time_color <- "white"
if(current_time == "from_params") {
  current_time <- Sys.time()
  current_time_color <- "orange"
  # current_time <- paste0('<span style="background-color: orange;">', current_time, '</span>')
}
# 3. Resto de la Información de Tiempo (no necesita cambios de locale)
local_time_full <- format(current_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z") 
local_time_full <- paste0('<span style="background-color: ', current_time_color, ';">', local_time_full, '</span>')
  
utc_time_full <- format(current_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")
utc_time_full <- paste0('<span style="background-color: ', current_time_color, ';">', utc_time_full, '</span>')

system_time_full <- local_time_full 
system_time_full <- paste0('<span style="background-color: ', current_time_color, ';">', system_time_full, '</span>')

tz_info <- Sys.timezone()
tz_info <- paste0('<span style="background-color: ', current_time_color, ';">', tz_info, '</span>')

  # current_time <- paste0('<span style="background-color: orange;">', current_time, '</span>')
  # current_time <- paste0('<span style="background-color: orange;">', current_time, '</span>')
  # current_time <- paste0('<span style="background-color: orange;">', current_time, '</span>')
####----------------------------------------------------------------------------
script_used <-  params$"script_used"
if(script_used == "from_params"){
  script_used <- "Script XXX-001"
  script_used <- paste0('<span style="background-color: orange;">', script_used, '</span>')
} 
####----------------------------------------------------------------------------

the_package <- params$"the_package"
if(the_package == "from_params"){
  the_package <- "Rscience"
  #the_package <- "agricolae"
  #the_package <- paste0('<span style="background-color: orange;">', the_package, '</span>')
} 

if (the_package %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]) {
  package_version_info <- paste0(the_package, " ", as.character(packageVersion(the_package)))
} else {
  package_version_info <- paste0(the_package, " ", "1.0.13")
  package_version_info <- paste0('<span style="background-color: orange;">', 
                                 package_version_info, '</span>')
  
}
####----------------------------------------------------------------------------

tool_used <- params$"tool_used"
if(tool_used == "from_params"){
  tool_used <- "General Linear Model - Fixed Effect - Balanced Tratments - Anova - Anova 1 Way"
  tool_used <- paste0('<span style="background-color: orange;">', tool_used, '</span>')
} else tool_used <- tool_used_styled <- paste0(
  '<span style="background-color: green; font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.2em; color: white; padding: 2px;">', 
  tool_used, 
  '</span>'
)


```


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

cat('
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  setTimeout(function() {
    const tabContainer = document.querySelector(".panel-tabset.nav-pills.nav-fill.flex-column");
    
    if (tabContainer) {
      const nav = tabContainer.querySelector(".nav");
      const tabContent = tabContainer.querySelector(".tab-content");
      
      if (nav && tabContent) {
        // Orden deseado
        const desiredOrder = [
          "Init",
          "Theory",
          "ClassRoom",
          "AutoReport", 
          "Data Analysis (Step by step)",
          "ASA",
          "Rscience Code",
          "Others"
        ];
        
        // Reordenar pestañas en el nav (botones)
        desiredOrder.forEach(function(tabTitle) {
          const navItems = Array.from(nav.querySelectorAll(".nav-item"));
          const targetNavItem = navItems.find(item => 
            item.querySelector(".nav-link").textContent.trim() === tabTitle
          );
          if (targetNavItem) {
            nav.appendChild(targetNavItem);
          }
        });
        
        // Reordenar contenido (paneles)
        desiredOrder.forEach(function(tabTitle) {
          const tabPanes = Array.from(tabContent.querySelectorAll(".tab-pane"));
          const targetPane = tabPanes.find(pane => {
            const link = document.querySelector(`[href="#${pane.id}"]`);
            return link && link.textContent.trim() === tabTitle;
          });
          if (targetPane) {
            tabContent.appendChild(targetPane);
          }
        });
      }
    }
  }, 300);
});
</script>
')
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

cat('
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  setTimeout(function() {
    // Seleccionar solo el contenedor principal con la clase .main-tabs
    const mainTabContainer = document.querySelector(".panel-tabset.nav-pills.nav-fill.flex-column.main-tabs");
    
    if (mainTabContainer) {
      const nav = mainTabContainer.querySelector(".nav");
      
      if (nav) {
        // Seleccionar la primera pestaña del nivel principal
        const firstNavItem = nav.querySelector(".nav-item:first-child");
        
        if (firstNavItem) {
          const firstLinkToActivate = firstNavItem.querySelector(".nav-link");
          
          // Usar la API de Bootstrap para activar correctamente
          if (typeof bootstrap !== "undefined" && bootstrap.Tab) {
            const tab = new bootstrap.Tab(firstLinkToActivate);
            tab.show();
          } else {
            // Fallback si Bootstrap no está disponible
            firstLinkToActivate.click();
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }, 400); // Un poco después del reordenamiento
});
</script>
')
```
